mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a permeable and an impermeable walkway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between permeable and impermeable walkways depends on your property's drainage needs, local regulations, and aesthetic preferences. Permeable walkways, such as those made with permeable pavers or decomposed granite, allow rainwater to filter through to the ground below, reducing runoff and replenishing groundwater. They are often favored for eco-friendly designs and can help manage stormwater. Impermeable walkways, like solid concrete or mortared stone, direct water to a specific drainage point. Consider your landscape's existing drainage and any desire to reduce stormwater impact when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose permeable walkways to reduce runoff and improve drainage, or impermeable for directed water flow. Consider environmental benefits and existing landscape drainage when deciding.
